pages.text: A Monitoring Crystal can be used to add the tracking capabilities of a Radiant storage container to a non-Arcane Archives inventory, such as a vanilla chest. It is also a light source.

The contents of inventories with an attached Monitoring Crystal can be seen and tracked with a $(l:items/manifest)Manifest$() as though they were a Radiant storage container. You cannot attach a Monitoring Crystal to $(l:blocks/radiant_chest)Radiant Chests$(), $(l:blocks/radiant_tank)Tanks$(), or $(l:blocks/radiant_trove)Troves$(); these devices appear in your Manifest automatically.
pages.title: Manifest

pages.text: Using a $(l:items/scepter_revelation)Scepter of Revelation$() on a Monitoring Crystal will return what direction the Monitoring Crystal is pointing towards.
pages.title: Scepter of Revelation
Lore
pages.text: $(bold)$(italics)The Creed of Branding$()$(br2)$(italics)The promise and distinction you have displayed have earned you the right to call yourself a Master of the Eternal University. As of this moment, you are born anew, free of the shackles of Apprenticeship.$(br2)Your forehead shall bear the Brand of Monitoring, and with it we shall watch you. Observation breeds honesty,$()

$(italics)and honesty breeds Temperance.$(br2)Enlightenment is the right of the strong, and no strength can be found in intemperate acts.$(br2)Trust in the judgment of the Quadrate, and the Magistocracy will trust in your works.$(br2)Bask in the light of your Enlightenment, Master, and walk ever on the path of Wisdom.$()
